rationale: The redesign adopts the working diagnosis's highest-value structural change without assuming the missing proof. It removes the direct full-register product and hundreds-of-entities acquisition model, makes an outsourced compliance or audit operator the single portfolio payer, narrows the control point to measurable preflight and rejection repair, and gates production development on a paid 12-month multi-entity minimum. A 45,000 PLN staged capital requirement, partner-minimum pricing hypothesis, measured benchmark, reduced document custody, and portfolio economics directly target distribution, differentiation, security burden, and payback. Exact incumbents, free official workflows, absent partner commitment, unknown demand, accuracy, procurement, retention, liability, and data rights remain explicit; failure to secure the commercial gate ends the build rather than being treated as validation.
